segments.title: 6. v9 Style: faces, colours, variants
lines: Start tab > step 4 STYLE has three tabs: Faces, Colours, Variants.
Each Preview runs a real 1-move build through forge.py (a few seconds).
Shown on the fictional mannequin. On a photo character, faces and colours
are procedural edits of YOUR photo's own pixels and are labelled ESTIMATED.

script.cap: Start tab: a mannequin character (fictional, procedural)
Step 4 STYLE > Faces: Automatic gives every move a face
Preview: neutral, happy, angry, hurt, shout, taunt, blink + 8 mouth shapes
Change any move: punch = shout, victory = taunt
A line of dialogue -> talk/ strip with mouth shapes from the letters
Colours: one-click sets, per-region colours, texture overlays
Kerry green & gold (with its chest band)
Team Blue + blond hair + white hoops overlay
Variants: a crowd from one character, every one reproducible from its seed
What to make > Extras: frame data, foot lock, QA, physics, fx, maps, blend, LODs
Build: the same settings as a forge.py command you can copy

segments.title: Same thing from the command line
lines: forge.py recolor out/hero --set kerry        forge.py variants --npc goblin -n 12
